{{Top|leg}}
'''Kris''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Kris commented on the effectiveness of [[dura-armor]] in combat. Kris was modifying modern [[duraplas]] into a form of [[link armor]], and advertized for field testers to contact them at the [[Ace of Sabres]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
